use_cases: Displaying animated glitch text effects for hero sections and landing pages
Creating cyberpunk or tech-focused branding elements
Adding visual interest to headers and titles in creative portfolios
Enhancing error pages or 404 messages with stylized typography
Highlighting key feature names in product marketing materials
ai_summary: A glitch text component that renders animated text with visual distortion effects, featuring multiple color schemes including rainbow, blue, purple, cyan, pink, and orange gradients. The component supports adjustable glitch intensity levels from light to extreme and can be toggled to static mode. Ideal for creating cyberpunk-inspired typography in hero sections, tech branding, and creative landing pages.
